refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewFromFloat` function generates a new leaf node from a floating-point value.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewFromFloat` returns a pointer to a new leaf `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object with the value passed on success, or `NULL` if there was a memory error.
